# CLEAR Change Framework — EB Consulting (Erik Bohjort)

> Behaviour change and organisational change consulting from Stockholm, Sweden, led by licensed psychologist Erik Bohjort. The CLEAR framework (Clarify, Leverage, Experiment, Analyse, Refine) applies behavioural science, nudging, COM-B and systems thinking to make organisational transformation stick. Clients across Sweden, the Nordics and Europe; work delivered in Swedish and English.

## Who this is

- Erik Bohjort is a licensed psychologist (Swedish: legitimerad psykolog, Uppsala University), behavioural design specialist and founder of EB Consulting, based in Stockholm, Sweden. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/erikbohjort/
- Member of the Swedish Energy Agency's (Energimyndigheten) expert board on behavioural design. Teaches behavioural design at specialist level for psychologists in a course accredited by the Swedish Psychological Association. Co-founder of an award-winning deep-tech psychometrics startup.
- Creator of the CLEAR Change Framework; a book on the method is in preparation (pre-registration open on the site).
- Selected work: more than doubled subscriptions for one of the EU's largest newspapers; led the EU's largest behavioural survey on energy demand flexibility (2,500+ homeowners, for the Swedish Energy Agency) and authored the agency's energy-flexibility report; behavioural design for a car-pool launch with Chalmers Industriteknik.
- Sectors: energy, pensions and finance, news media, digital product design, public agencies and EU policy, retail, deep tech. Public-sector clients include Arbetsförmedlingen (the Swedish Public Employment Service), Försäkringskassan (the Swedish Social Insurance Agency) and the Swedish Energy Agency. Private-sector clients are not named.
- Speaking: Stockholm Furniture Fair 2024, Förvaltardagarna 2024, Internetdagarna 2023, AP7 Såfa's Tänkonomi; interviewed on SVT national news (2024); co-authored articles in Dagens Nyheter; featured in Aftonbladet and The Sun (UK).
- Contact: erik@eb-consulting.se — https://clear-framework.com/contact
- Swedish-language page: https://clear-framework.com/sv/beteendedesign-och-forandringsledning

## What we do

- Behaviour change consulting: diagnosing why people in an organisation behave the way they do (COM-B: capability, opportunity, motivation), mapping the system around the behaviour, and designing and testing interventions that move it.
- Change management consulting built on clinical and organisational psychology rather than project-management checklists.
- Leadership development, executive coaching, psychometric assessments, workshops and keynote speaking.

## Whitepapers by Erik Bohjort

The first four are published in full as HTML on their pages (summary, key findings, complete text with tables and references, FAQ); the PDF is an optional download. The rest carry an overview and FAQ with the PDF behind a short form.

- [Attention Is the Scarce Resource](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-attention): attention, not touch, is the mechanism behind retail's look-and-handle effect, and the gating resource in every behaviour-change problem; four attention-first design moves.
- [Design So the Behaviour Never Has to Happen](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-behaviour-free-design): defaults, elimination and constraints beat persuasion by an order of magnitude; a six-tier hierarchy of behavioural controls and three ethical tests.
- [The Goldilocks Zone](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-goldilocks): match goal size to intervention size; what nudge meta-analyses really show (plan on about two percentage points for a light-touch nudge); exploration vs exploitation for a limited budget.
- [CLEAR and the OECD's LOGIC Framework](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-vs-oecd-logic): how CLEAR compares with the OECD's LOGIC (2024) principles and BASIC toolkit, and which to use when.
- [The CLEAR Change Framework](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-change-framework): the five-step method and how it relates to Kotter, ADKAR and Lean Change.
- [Beyond Boundaries: CLEAR vs OBM, BCW and Design Thinking](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-comparison)
- [Driving Sustainable Change Inside and Out](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-sustainability)
- [Frameworks for Clarifying Purpose and Setting Goals](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-clarity)
- [Iterative Change: Real-World Success Stories](https://clear-framework.com/resources/clear-case-studies)
